jobs.title: Senior engineer elektrotechniek
jobs.description:
**Wat ga je doen en waar draag je aan bij?**
--------------------------------------------


Binnen Waterschap Amstel, Gooi en Vecht (AGV) zijn we op zoek naar een ervaren senior engineer elektrotechniek. De afdeling Projecten is volop bezig met het realiseren van projecten in het waterschap. Denk aan de bouw en renovatie van waterzuiveringsinstallaties, gemalen, pompstations, dijkverbetering\- en waterinrichtingsplannen in het verzorgingsgebied van AGV. Maar ook het bijdragen aan de nieuwe uitdagingen, zoals de energietransitie, terugwinning van grondstoffen, duurzaamheid, circulair bouwen enz. Dit vormt een deel van de werkzaamheden van de afdeling Projecten. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, configureren en onderhouden van elektrotechnische installaties in de energie\- en infrastructuur sector.


Verantwoordelijkheden:

* Ontwerpen van elektrotechnische installaties voor energie\- en infrastructuurprojecten;
* Configureren en inbedrijfstellen van installaties;
* Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en geeft advies over de meest optimale oplossingsrichting;
* Coördineren en begeleiden van projecten;
* Verantwoordelijk voor het werken aan grotere en innovatieve projecten, voornamelijk op het gebied van zuiveringsprocessen, waarbij je bijdraagt aan de realisatie van "schoon water";
* Je fungeert als het aanspreekpunt voor de discipline binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams en werkt samen met andere disciplines binnen de afdeling, zoals werktuigbouw en procesautomatisering en andere stakeholders;
* Samen met je team ontwerp je, bereid je voor, voer je uit en sluit je complexe projecten af;
* Je ondersteunt de projectmanager en stelt contractdocumenten op in samenwerking met andere disciplines;
* Je participeert in aanbestedingsprocedures en verstrekt opdrachten aan aannemers of opdrachtnemers.


Als elektrotechnisch aanspreekpunt lever je bijdragen aan projectplanningen, kostenramingen en risicoanalyses om alle fases van het project succesvol af te ronden. Je volgt en werkt volgens de AGV\-methodiek: standaard aanpak projecten (SAP); Je draagt bij aan het opstellen van projectrapportages en overdracht van het projectresultaat aan de interne opdrachtgever, inclusief advisering over het vervolg en evaluatie van het project. Tot slot verhoog je de kwaliteit van de producten van het team door middel van kwaliteitstoetsingen.

**Welkom in het team**
----------------------


Je gaat aan de slag bij Waterschap Amstel, Gooi en Vecht (AGV); een nieuwe waterschapsorganisatie die zich inzet voor waterveiligheid en werkt aan schoon water en voldoende water. Ons werkgebied is veelzijdig: van de stedelijke dynamiek van Amsterdam tot uitgestrekte weilanden en natuurlijke plassengebieden. Klimaatverandering en bevolkingsgroei zorgen voor complexe uitdagingen, waarop we innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen vinden. AGV beheert dijken, gemalen en waterzuiveringsinstallaties en werkt samen met overheden en partners om het watersysteem toekomstbestendig te houden Het waterschap werkt met de nieuwste technieken en is bijna 100% klimaatneutraal. Bij ons werken echte vakmensen: van dijkinspecteur tot dataspecialist en van techneut tot teamleider. Al deze betrokken medewerkers maken Amstel, Gooi en Vecht samen tot een werkgever waar je jezelf kan zijn. Wij stimuleren je om elke dag een stukje beter te worden. Je vindt dan ook een groot aanbod aan opleidingen en trainingen bij onze eigen Academie. Als organisatie werken we samen volgens de volgende kernwaarden: deskundig, dichtbij, dapper en duurzaam.

**Wat breng je mee?**
---------------------

* Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in elektrotechniek
* Ten minste 5 jaar ervaring als elektrotechnisch engineer of adviseur met de hierboven genoemde werkzaamheden in ons werkgebied of namens een vergelijkbare overheid (drinkwaterbedrijf of waterschap)
* Ervaring met ontwerpen en configureren van elektrotechnische installaties
* Jij ben in het bezit van een geldig VCA en rijbewijs
* Kennis van relevante normen en wetgeving op het gebied van elektrotechniek en duurzame energie
* Jij kan zelfstandig Net\-, kortsluit\-, selectiviteit\-, kabelberekeningen maken
* Kan advies uitbrengen over te gebruiken onderdelen en materialen in bestaande en nieuwe e\-installaties
* Je hebt ervaring met het werken in een vergelijkbare (semi\-) ambtelijke omgeving
* Je hebt ervaring in multidisciplinaire projectteams
* Je hebt ervaring met verschillende contractvormen, zoals UAV\-2012, UAV\-GC en RAW
* Kennis van licht, kracht, besturingstechniek, de gebruikelijke NEN\-normen (NEN 1010 en de NEN 3140\), CE\-normen en wettelijke regelgeving
* Affiniteit met automatisering (PLC’s)


Je kunt samenwerken, bent flexibel en stressbestendig. Je hebt een hoog veiligheidsbewustzijn en werkt zorgvuldig. Je bent besluitvaardig, probleemoplossend, resultaatgericht en kostenbewust. Je bent communicatief (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk), besluitvaardig en hebt een proactieve houding. Je hebt gevoel bij de omgeving, toont initiatief en bent innovatief.

**Dit krijg je ervoor terug**
-----------------------------


Als je bij Amstel, Gooi en Vecht werkt, heb je uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Max € 5\.848,\- (schaal 10\) bruto per maand voor 36 uur per week (inclusief 21% IKB max € 7\.076,\-)

jobs.title: Commissioning and Service Engineer
jobs.description:
De wereld van TenneT is hoogspannend. Als Commissioning \& Service Engineer voel je dit als geen ander. Zonder jou valt de wereld om ons heen stil. Dat is de impact die jouw baan heeft. Waar voor anderen elektriciteit vanzelfsprekend is, is het voor jou een uitdaging om te zorgen dat het er altijd is. Een dag in de hoogspanning is een dag in het spannendste en mooiste gebied in de elektrotechniek. Maar ook 's nachts je bed uit komen om een storing op te lossen, zodat de rest van Nederland aan een dag kan beginnen waarin het licht het weer doet. Het werkgebied voor deze rol is Brabant.
### **Jouw bijdrage aan TenneT**


In de rol van meetspecialist hoogspanningsinstallaties heb je veel vrijheid om je werk zelf in te delen en uit te voeren. Daarom beschik jij over een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en pak je zaken proactief op. Wat ga je doen als meetspecialist hoogspanningsinstallaties?
* Uitvoeren van functionele en technische metingen en testen bij onderhoudswerkzaamheden, 1 op 1 vervangingsprojecten, bij grote projecten, als deelnemer van het testteam, of aan de instrumentatie transformatoren.
* Uitvoeren van systeeminspecties, parametreren en onderhouden.
* Analyseren en beoordelen van de meetresultaten; je rapporteert deze en brengt advies uit aan de Kennisdrager.
* Rapporteren van meetresultaten (o.a. storingen en afwijkingen) en adviseren over risico's en mogelijke oplossingen.
* In opdracht schakelen en veiligstellen van de secundaire / primaire HS\-installatie. Hierin heb je een duidelijke helicopterview en weet je de gevolgen te overzien.
* Kennis van nieuwe installaties borgen in de Area' s en tussen specialisten (bijvoorbeeld door middel van cursussen en presentaties)
* Deelnemen aan de storingswachtdienst.
### **Jouw profiel en achtergrond**


Bij TenneT zoeken we professionals die bijdragen aan de toekomst van ons elektriciteitsnet. We verwachten dat je de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden hebt om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan ons team en onze missie.
**Wat breng jij mee?**
* Je hebt een mbo\+ en/of hbo werk\- en denkniveau en minimaal een afgeronde mbo niveau 4 opleiding in de richting van Elektrotechniek of Energietechniek (of vergelijkbare certificaten);
* Je hebt kennis van HS aanleg primair / secundair of bent bereid deze op te doen;
* Je bent analytisch sterk en zorgvuldig;
* Je bent een kei in communiceren (in woord en geschrift) en je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband uit de voeten;
* Je hebt een flexibele werkinstelling en je kunt goed met veranderingen omgaan. Je hebt oog voor verbeteringen en vernieuwingen;
* Je toont zelfstandigheid, initiatief en het vermogen om in teamverband te werken (relevante competenties). Daarnaast beschik je uiteraard over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en spreek je zeer goed Nederlands.
* Last but not least is veilig werken voor jou geen discussiepunt.
### **Ons recruitment process**


### **Ons aanbod**


Flexibility
**Werk en privé in balans, op een manier die bij jou past.** Bij TenneT krijg je de ruimte om flexibel te werken, zowel qua werktijden als werklocatie. Of je nu thuiswerkt, op kantoor bent of tijdelijk een andere werk\-privéverdeling nodig hebt: we denken graag met je mee. Zo creëer jij de balans die nodig is om duurzaam succesvol te zijn.

  


Payment \& more
**Goede prestaties verdienen een uitstekende waardering.** Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met onder meer een vast contract bij indiensttreding, een ruim aantal verlofdagen, een sterke pensioenregeling en extra financiële voordelen zoals een eindejaarsuitkering. Zo kun jij met vertrouwen bouwen aan je toekomst.

  


Wellness
  

Balance \&
  

Personal Growth
**Jouw gezondheid is de basis voor duurzame energie, én voor jouw succes.** Daarom investeren we actief in jouw fysieke en mentale welzijn. Met ons Always Energy\-programma, bijdragen voor sport en zorg, én aandacht voor vitaliteit helpen we je om fit, energiek en veerkrachtig te blijven.

  


Technology \&
  

Innovation
**Werken in een omgeving die inspireert en verbindt.** Van ons hoofdkantoor aan de rand van landgoed Mariëndaal tot moderne werkplekken op onze locaties: je vindt overal ruimte om samen te werken, te ontmoeten, te focussen en ideeën tot leven te brengen. Een fijne werkdag begint immers bij een inspirerende werkomgeving.

  


### **Onze uitdaging**


Onshore zorgt voor de veilige, tijdige en betrouwbare realisatie van nieuwe aansluitingen en netverzwaringen op land. Daarnaast onderhoudt deze divisie het bestaande net en optimaliseert zij het gebruik ervan, zodat overal het licht blijft branden.
  

  

De kerntaken van Onshore zijn projectontwikkeling en \-realisatie, onderhoud en assetmanagement, vergunningen, veiligheid, standaarden en kwaliteitsborging. De focus ligt op samenwerking en voorspelbaarheid voor klanten en andere stakeholders.
### **Extra informatie**


TenneT biedt jou de kans om bij te dragen aan een duurzame energietoekomst. Samen met collega’s, partners en stakeholders werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen die de energietransitie mogelijk maken. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je talent te ontwikkelen en werk je in een omgeving waarin jouw groei centraal staat. Wij stimuleren initiatief en geven je de ruimte om met nieuwe ideeën te komen. Wij bieden jou:

* Een salaris in schaal 6: €3691 tot €6493 per maand met 8% vakantiegeld en 6% eindejaarsuitkering.
* Een solide pensioen via ABP: wij betalen 70% van jouw premie.
* 43 verlofdagen per jaar.
* Alle genoemde arbeidsvoorwaarden gelden bij een fulltime dienstverband, tenzij anders vermeld.
* Hybride werken wanneer mogelijk, inclusief een reiskosten\-, internet\- en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
* Ondersteuning voor jouw vitaliteit, met een bijdrage voor een sportabonnement en zorgverzekering en ons Always Energy programma.
* Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden via de TenneT Academy, zodat jij je kennis en vaardigheden kunt blijven uitbreiden.
Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Neem dan contact op met **Hedwig van Bree** via **Hedwig.van.Bree@TenneT.eu**. Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met **Martin Kouters** via **Martin.Kouters@TenneT.eu**.

jobs.description:
**About the role** **Job Title**: Site Engineer


**Location:** Aberdeen


**Project Type:** Civils / Energy


**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group



Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.



The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.



Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.



By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  


* Ensure all works are delivered safely and in accordance with Balfour Beatty and SSEN health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Manage and supervise day\-to\-day site activities across earthworks, drainage, roads, ducting, foundations and utility installations.
* Set out works accurately in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and project tolerances.
* Conduct site surveys and maintain survey control points throughout construction.
* Review construction drawings and technical information, identifying and resolving engineering issues before works commence.
* Produce and maintain quality records, inspection test plans (ITPs), check sheets and as\-built documentation.
* Monitor subcontractor performance to ensure compliance with programme, quality and safety requirements.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil, HVDC, substation, cable and building work packages.
* Manage permits, temporary works requirements and engineering compliance on site.
* Assist with short\-term planning and ensure work activities are delivered in line with the project programme.
* Identify and implement productivity improvements and value engineering opportunities.
* Maintain accurate daily records, site diaries and progress reports.
* Support commercial teams through measurement of completed works and validation of subcontractor claims.
* Ensure environmental controls are implemented, particularly regarding drainage, water management, protected species and ecological constraints.
* Participate in site inspections, audits and client progress meetings.
* Raise and close out NCRs, defects and quality issues in a timely manner.
* Coordinate material deliveries, plant requirements and logistics activities to maintain efficient site operations.
* Support testing and commissioning activities associated with substations, cable routes and associated infrastructure.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with SSEN, designers, subcontractors and local stakeholders.
* Mentor graduate and assistant engineers, promoting best practice and engineering excellence.

 **Who we're looking for**  


* Degree, HNC, HND or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Valid CSCS card (Academically or Professionally Qualified Person).
* Full UK driving licence
* Previous experience working as a Site Engineer on major infrastructure, transmission, power, energy, highways or civil engineering projects.
* Experience of setting out earthworks, roads, drainage, reinforced concrete and utility installations.
* Knowledge of quality assurance processes, Inspection Test Plans (ITPs) and completion documentation.
* Experience managing subcontractors and coordinating multiple work fronts.
* Familiarity with NEC contracts and collaborative delivery environments.
* Experience working within strict health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Previous involvement in substation, HVDC, overhead line or utility infrastructure projects would be advantageous given the project scope.

 **Why work for us** **Professional \& Personal Development**



The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.



We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.



We're also very proud of our Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified.


* Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low\-carbon future.
* Work on challenging, high\-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi\-disciplinary team.
* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.
* Enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.


**For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland \- You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section**

 **About us**  

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.



We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.



Our award\-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.


**Diversity and inclusion**



At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion



To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.



As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/



We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com

Develop and deliver Main Plant engineering solutions for transmission networks (132kV and above), producing engineering specifications, designs and technical support throughout the project lifecycle. The role includes design calculations, reports, drawings, standards development and technical expertise for Main Plant equipment installations across ScottishPower Transmission projects.

  

* Develop Main Plant and auxiliary equipment requirements for project specifications, authorisations and construction programmes.
* Produce engineering designs and specifications for switchgear, transformers and other primary plant equipment.
* Review tender submissions, assess technical compliance and approve design drawings and documentation.
* Ensure designs meet current legislation, operational requirements and industry standards.

* Degree in Engineering, or HND with relevant industry experience.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of CDM regulations and health \& safety best practice within a design environment.
* Understanding of transmission substation plant and associated equipment.
* Experience of electrical infrastructure projects and transmission or distribution networks.
* Knowledge of one or more of the following: Switchgear, Transformers, Transmission Systems or Distribution Network Design (33kV to 400kV).

* Engineering Degree or HND with relevant experience.
* Experience in electrical substation design for infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of transmission and/or distribution network plant and equipment.
* Full UK driving licence.

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

  

  

At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. * Share Incentive Plan and Sharesave Scheme
* Payroll giving and charity matched funding

* Count us in – pledge to reduce carbon emissions and help fight climate change

* Cycle to Work scheme and public transport season ticket loans
* Options to purchase dental insurance, private medical insurance, health cash plan and annual health assessments

* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. #### **About us**


Qurant is on a mission to make employee health more proactive, measurable and sustainable.  

Through our health platform and close collaboration with HR and leadership teams, we help organisations spot early signs of ill health and build healthier workplaces. We are proud of our customer satisfaction and are growing our team to help even more companies make proactive health a natural part of working life.  

Qurant is an independent company within the Capio Group.

#### **About the role**


We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our growing product team.  

You will work across our product: a Laravel\-based web portal used by Swedish employers to manage employee absence and health, as well as a new mobile app currently in development.  

We are a small team, which means no rigid “web person” or “mobile person” roles. We collaborate, learn from each other and pitch in where the product needs us. You will help build new features, improve performance and reliability, and make thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.  

As we work with sensitive personal data, quality, security and good engineering practices matter a lot to us.

#### **What you’ll do**

* Develop and maintain features across our web portal and mobile app
* Work hands\-on with PHP, Laravel, relational databases and integrations
* Improve application and database performance, including queries and indexing
* Navigate technical debt, legacy patterns and ongoing improvements with pragmatism
* Collaborate on code reviews, technical decisions and product development
* Work with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployments
* Learn new technologies and contribute wherever the team needs you

#### **We think you’ll thrive here if you have**

* 5\+ years of experience building and maintaining production software
* Strong experience with a server\-rendered web framework, such as Laravel, Symfony, Rails, Django or ASP.NET Core
* A genuine interest in working with PHP and Laravel day to day
* Solid relational database skills, including query optimisation and performance troubleshooting
* Experience working in existing codebases—not just greenfield projects
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and a major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to pick up unfamiliar technologies
* Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a strong advantage

##### **Nice to have**
**Experience with any of the following is a bonus:**

* Flutter, React Native or native mobile development
* GDPR or sensitive personal data in healthcare, finance or another regulated setting
* Multi\-tenant SaaS products
* AI coding assistants and agentic workflows
* Livewire, Alpine.js, Blade, Vue, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Kubernetes or PostgreSQL

##### **For the technically curious (and the proud tech nerds), here’s our stack:**

  

Laravel / PHP, Livewire 3, Alpine.js, Blade, Bootstrap 5 / SCSS, MySQL / MariaDB, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions and Azure Container Apps with Bicep.  

Our mobile app is built in Flutter. We also work with OAuth, webhooks, SFTP\-based file flows and integrations such as Försäkringskassan. Some parts of the frontend still use jQuery—because real\-life codebases are rarely built in a day.

#### **What we offer**

* A meaningful role in a growing health\-tech company
* A collaborative team with plenty of room to influence both product and technology
* The chance to work across web, mobile, cloud and integrations
* Central Stockholm offices on Drottninggatan, with hybrid work options

##### **How to apply**


Want to help us build healthier workplaces across Sweden? We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.  

Start date: autumn or as agreed.  

  

**Questions?**  

Contact Sandra Jakobsson at **sandra.jakobsson@capio.se**

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in Netherlands.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.

You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.

A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.

You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.

The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.

You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.

This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

Requirements

3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer Mid 1

Blip is a leading tech company focused on software engineering solutions for sports entertainment.

We operate at scale. As part of Flutter Entertainment, we play an essential role in the Group's goal of becoming the global leader in online sports betting and iGaming, developing innovative products and platforms for over 14 million monthly customers worldwide.

We are serious about Tech. We are problem-solvers with big ambitions, keeping a people-first mindset at the core of our work. We prioritize flexibility as we strive to deliver the best technological products and tackle the greatest industry challenges.

Recognizing that everyone brings their own strengths, backgrounds and new perspectives, we empower you to be yourself. That uniqueness shapes the culture of belonging we are so proud of.

The Role

We are looking for a skilled hybrid engineer to join a dedicated, specialized team focused on driving

the Quality Engineering strategy across our area. Instead of working within a single product squad,

you will use your full-stack development skills to help build and maintain internal platforms, tooling,

and robust automation frameworks that empower all engineering teams to deliver with excellence.

Reporting to an Engineering Manager, you will act as a key bridge between software development

and quality assurance. You will collaborate on solutions that enhance system resilience, automate

testing scenarios, and elevate our technical standards. If you are a builder who loves solving

structural problems, writing clean code (from Go to React), and creating tools that make other

developers' lives easier, this is the role for you

What You’ll Be Doing

Platform & Tooling Development: Use your full-stack skills to develop and maintaininternal tools, dashboards (React/Next.js), and backend services (Golang) designed tomonitor and enhance product quality.
Quality Strategy Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers and management toimplement and evolve the quality engineering strategy, helping to establish best practicesand metrics for product teams.
Automation Frameworks: Build, maintain, and scale test automation frameworks (API,Integration, End-to-End) that can be easily adopted by distributed product teams.
Resilience Engineering: Help design and implement automated processes thatcontinuously validate system resilience, data integrity, and high availability across ourarchitecture.
CI/CD Integration: Work on integrating testing platforms directly into our CI/CD pipelines,ensuring deployments remain rapid, reliable, and automated.
Quality Advocacy: Act as a quality advocate for product squads. Participate in cross-teamcode reviews and help champion Test-Driven approaches (like BDD and ATDD).

What You’ll Bring

Software Development Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience with back-end programming(e.g., Golang, C#) and working experience (1+ years) in front-end development with Reactand its ecosystem.
Quality & Automation Focus: Experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test(SDET), Quality Engineer, or a Full-Stack Developer with a heavy focus on automatedtesting and tooling.
System Architecture & Resilience: Good understanding of system design, data flow, andexperience working with distributed systems and messaging (e.g., Kafka, SQS, Kinesis).
Testing Frameworks: Practical knowledge of testing at the API layer (e.g., REST), UIautomation, and an understanding of BDD and ATDD methodologies. Database Knowledge: Experience with SQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) andfamiliarity with NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) or caching (e.g., Redis).
DevOps & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control(Git/GitHub), Linux navigation, and basic shell scripting.
Communication: Clear and collaborative communication skills, with the ability to documenttechnical designs, write runbooks, and work proactively in a dynamic environment.

This is what you should have. What do we have, you ask? Well...you can check our amazing perks & benefits
right here! 

So ... are you in?

regardless of their race, disability, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, and religion.
